story.headline: The Three-Peat Bid
story.text: Dan Hurley turned down Kentucky and the Los Angeles Lakers to chase a third straight title, something no team had done since UCLA's run ended in 1973. It was a bumpy ride: after climbing to No. 2, UConn lost all three games at the Maui Invitational — to Memphis in overtime, Colorado and Dayton. Freshman Liam McNeeley was Big East Freshman of the Year (with a 38-point night against Creighton), Tarris Reed Jr. was Sixth Man of the Year and Solo Ball broke out, and the Huskies finished third at 14–6. They beat Villanova in the Big East quarterfinals before Creighton won the semifinal, and as a No. 8 seed they beat Oklahoma 67–59. In the second round, top-seeded Florida — the eventual champion — ended the three-peat bid 77–75.
